description: Greater New York Area Flash Flood Inundation Estimation Based on NOAA Storm Events Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Seonho Kim, Fatemeh Yavari (City College of New York). Greater New York Area Flash Flood Inundation Estimation Based on NOAA Storm Events Data This dataset was used as ground truth in the research article by Kim et al. (2025). Contents: The dataset contains the following materials: 1. Flash flood event narratives (`Narratives.xlsx`) 2. Inundation depth estimations by domain experts (`Narratives.xlsx`) 3. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
